text:
nova: FYI bringing up Cust-Orion LoRA adapter 'NeonPatch' — int4 smoke found systematic magnitude shifts on monetary fields (lots of x100 errors). brief log snippet below.
nova: snippet:
```
pred: "Amount paid: $9,000"
truth: "Amount paid: $90.00"
conf: 0.95
```
riley: that usually points at tokenizer id mismatch or thousands/decimal token reassign. which tokenizer and merge settings?
drew: also check adapter vocab ordering; customers sometimes include locale tokens that collide.
nova: tokenizer redwood-core 3.0.1, merge = add-on (0.5 adapter weight) with bias-correction true. adapter vocab uploaded by customer.
sam: starting quick eval: `runpack --pack neonpatch --quant int4 --evalset invoices-l10n --seed 11` — ETA ~2.5m.
deploy-bot: neonpatch-quickpack (int4) started by sam. job id: np-5501.
sam: quickpack done — topline:
- accuracy: base 0.81 -> neonpatch int4 0.75 (-7.4%)
- numeric F1: 0.67 -> 0.56 (-0.11)
- avg magnitude error: 36x (many x100/x10)
- main failure: separator token remap + merge-scaling interaction
iris: run `tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base base-model --adapter neonpatch` and also try remap overlay 0.9/0.1 without bias-correction.
nova: tokenmap_diff shows comma and dot swapped between vocab tables and adapter adds a THOUSAND token at a different index.
riley: quick mitigation: remap adapter indices to base before serializing and re-eval. fallback plan: float16 shadow.
drew: alternative: hybrid quant (first 4 layers int8, rest int4) plus 128-sample act-calib. often stabilizes numeric transforms.
sam: kicked two jobs: np-5502 (remap + overlay 0.9/0.1) and np-5503 (hybrid-int8 + calib128 + remap).
deploy-bot: jobs np-5502, np-5503 started.
sam: results — np-5502 remap+overlay: numeric F1 0.62, avg error 1.9x, hallucination down to +1.8%
sam: results — np-5503 hybrid-int8+calib128+remap: numeric F1 0.64, avg error 1.05x, hallucination +0.9% (near baseline)
iris: conclusion: token id remap was primary root cause. hybrid-int8 with remap recovers behavior. propose adding tokenmap diff to adapter CI and a console preflight that warns on separator/currency id diffs.
nova: noted — will draft EOD to customer: recommend hybrid-int8 canary + tokenmap preflight; float16 shadow if needed.
riley: I'll add a small runtime toggle to remap adapter vocab on load and a unit test for thousands/decimal tokens.
drew: also add locale permutations to our quick-eval suite.
nova: thanks team — filing onboarding PR and canary playbook.
